entries.title: A review card's tradeoff chart keeps its full width
entries.body: When a reviewer laid out each option on its own row, the tradeoff chart on the card was squeezed into a narrow strip with its words broken a letter or two per line. The chart now spans the question's full width.
entries.noPicture: A fix to an existing view; the release's picture of the chart already shows it at full width.
